main_text.l: [illegible, ~3 letters]uit, nec solum à suis honos illi delatus, & ob cladem dextræ, quam ignibus torrendam iniecerat

tor, qui sine culpa, imo sine crimine possit infandum istud illius scelus celebrare? Is
non hostis dici potest, cum esset subditus, non inimicus, sed perduellis, non adolescens nobilis,

ptus, non patribus approbantibus, sed seditiosis concionatoribus, & Hispanicæ ac Guisianæ
factionis principibus suadentibus in Regis castra profectus est, vt eum necaret: cui non vile cor[illegible,

Many words in the left-hand part of each line are blotted out and are marked as illegible with approximate letter counts. The right-margin note beside the Navarre line is only partly legible and its reading is doubtful. The running head is "VINDICIÆ." and the page number is 191. The catchword "loan-" is at the lower right. Text in the first line is partly obscured.
